published_ranges._notes: UL 94 V-0. Marketing copy claims HDT 'up to 130°C after annealing' (not tabulated). Density is not published. The 320C top of the nozzle range is above the 300C limit of Bambu's X1/P1 stock hotends. Bambu's X1 Series page lists an 'All-Metal Hotend 300℃' (seen in a search preview), and E3D's FAQ for its Bambu-licensed X1/P1 hotend says 'The maximum printing temperature is 300 °C.' Check this against your printer's limit. Values gathered by a research sub-agent.
